expected.charges: Freedom Ride participation — rode the Illinois Central Railroad from New Orleans, arrested Jackson, June 20, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-06-20. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Sentenced to four months following the June 20, 1961 arrest. A contemporary Associated Press report states that he spent 23 days in Jackson and Parchman custody and was released after CORE paid a $500 fine. He returned to Berkeley on July 12. Release is recorded as July 1961 because the report does not distinguish the physical release day from the homecoming date.
